// MojakStaking — terminal deploy (Monad mainnet, chain 143)
// Run on your droplet where the deployer key lives. NEVER paste the key into chat.
//   npm i ethers   (if not already installed)
//   PRIVATE_KEY=0xyourkey node deploy-mojak.mjs
//
// Uses explicit gasLimit + legacy gasPrice + type:0 so ethers does NO gas
// estimation / fee-history calls (dodges the Monad "could not coalesce" bug).

import { JsonRpcProvider, Wallet } from "ethers";

const RPC    = "https://rpc.monad.xyz";
const CHAIN  = 143;
const TOKEN  = "0x84Ea11d047A8bB23149a2d79C3B14Ab5B5907777"; // $MOJAK
const DEV    = "0xE7A31FD91A6F2AB0c73Db3b7d0954a6a3AcC7aB5"; // devWallet (30% of penalties)
const BYTECODE = "";

const enc = (a) => a.toLowerCase().replace(/^0x/, "").padStart(64, "0");
const initcode = BYTECODE + enc(TOKEN) + enc(DEV);

const pk = process.env.PRIVATE_KEY;
if (!pk) { console.error("ERROR: set PRIVATE_KEY env var (deployer wallet). Do NOT hardcode it."); process.exit(1); }

const provider = new JsonRpcProvider(RPC, CHAIN);
const wallet   = new Wallet(pk, provider);

console.log("deployer :", wallet.address);
console.log("token    :", TOKEN);
console.log("devWallet:", DEV);
console.log("initcode :", (initcode.length - 2) / 2, "bytes");

const bal = await provider.getBalance(wallet.address);
console.log("MON bal  :", bal.toString(), "wei");
if (bal === 0n) { console.error("ERROR: deployer has 0 MON for gas."); process.exit(1); }

const nonce    = await provider.getTransactionCount(wallet.address);
const gasPrice = BigInt(await provider.send("eth_gasPrice", []));
console.log("nonce    :", nonce, "| gasPrice:", gasPrice.toString());

const tx = await wallet.sendTransaction({
  data: initcode,            // contract creation (no 'to')
  value: 0n,
  gasLimit: 6_000_000n,      // manual — skip estimator
  gasPrice,                  // legacy
  type: 0,                   // legacy tx — no feeHistory call
  nonce,
  chainId: CHAIN,
});
console.log("tx sent  :", tx.hash);
console.log("waiting for confirmation…");

const rcpt = await tx.wait();
if (rcpt.status !== 1) { console.error("DEPLOY REVERTED. status:", rcpt.status); process.exit(1); }

console.log("\n✅ DEPLOYED:", rcpt.contractAddress);
console.log("explorer  : https://monadscan.com/address/" + rcpt.contractAddress);
console.log("\n──────── paste this whole line back into chat ────────");
console.log("VERIFY " + rcpt.contractAddress + " token=" + TOKEN + " dev=" + DEV);
